title: OWASP ASVS verification
description: Project checks for choosing and tracking defensive application security requirements from ASVS 5.0, with the requirements of the chapters on authentication, authorization and input validation that most changes meet.

sources.title: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0, V2 Validation and Business Logic

rules.instruction: Confirm the ASVS version, verification level and in-scope component with the application's security owner. Record which requirements apply and why.
rules.verification: Check that control records identify the source version and cover changed assets, data and roles. Confirm any exclusions with the owner.

rules.instruction: For each applicable changed requirement, attach evidence from approved code review, configuration review or existing defensive verification.
rules.verification: Check that the evidence names the requirement and matches the code revision and environment being reviewed.

rules.instruction: Record unmet requirements and exceptions with an owner, scope and review date. Escalate blockers through the project's release process.
rules.verification: Verify that release evidence shows the decision for each open requirement and links to remediation or approval.

rules.instruction: When the change touches sign-in, passwords or account activation, verify it against ASVS 5.0 chapter V6 Authentication, such as 6.2.1 (passwords of at least 8 characters), 6.3.1 (controls against credential stuffing and password brute force) and 6.4.1 (initial passwords and activation codes securely randomly generated and short-lived).
rules.verification: Record for each requirement named whether the change meets it, with a test or the review that shows it.

rules.instruction: When the change exposes a function or data, verify it against ASVS 5.0 chapter V8 Authorization: 8.2.1 (function-level access only with explicit permissions), 8.2.2 (data-specific access only with explicit permissions to the items, against IDOR and BOLA) and 8.3.1 (rules enforced at a trusted service layer).
rules.verification: Run a test as a consumer without the permission for each changed function and data item and assert the refusal.

rules.instruction: When the change accepts input, verify it against ASVS 5.0 chapter V2 Validation and Business Logic: 2.1.1 (documented validation rules), 2.2.1 (positive validation against allowed values, patterns and ranges) and 2.2.2 (validation enforced at a trusted service layer).
rules.verification: Send values outside the documented rules to the changed entry points in a test and assert that the service rejects them.
